title: Lazar's Bendix Field Engineering badge as an intelligence cover

tellings.quote: We knew what that meant. And then when I saw Lazar's ID briefly in one book, there was a photo. There was a copy of it and I saw it and I said, "Holy [ __ ] Lazar worked for Bendix Field Engineering. That was his cover then.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who said he worked on alien craft at a secret site near Area 51 (a hidden US Air Force base in Nevada), had an ID badge from a company called Bendix Field Engineering, and according to the author Peter Levenda that badge was a cover for intelligence work. Levenda says he saw a copy of the ID in a photo in a book he does not name and thought, "Lazar worked for Bendix Field Engineering. That was his cover then," adding that people in his circles "knew what that meant." If he is right, Lazar's job was tied to the intelligence world and not just ordinary engineering.
